title: Does Mercor Record Your AI Interview? #Shorts
description:
Grammar and wording checks are fine. Using a model to compose your answers, rate model responses, generate rationales, or evaluate code is not. And what they keep is the video, the audio, and an AI-generated transcript — they say they do not sell it or train on it, and they also say you cannot have a copy.

Full breakdown of how Mercor works: https://youtu.be/Dd5UFR0pfvg
Source: talent.docs.mercor.com/policies/llm-usage

Nothing here is a guarantee of work, acceptance, or income.

#Mercor #AITrainingJobs #RemoteWork
